notes.title: DADOO's August 2024 Update: The Indonesian Independence Day Event
notes.content:
Greetings, DADOO Masters 

As we approach the [b]Indonesian Independence Day[/b], we're thrilled to bring you a special update filled with Indonesian-themed content to celebrate this momentous occasion. Our team has been working to create an “authentic” Indonesian experience for you. From lush greenery to a polluted city, from weird people rioting to saltwater crocodile chilling, we present you the Indonesian Independence Day Update! 

Here’s what you can look forward to in this update: 

[h1]New Map: Nusantara Map[/h1]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/a8e27c8bced951e9aef3126c7ede0a25d1171d77.png[/img]

Explore the beauty and diversity of Indonesia with our new Nusantara Map. This map is not only packed with the beautiful sides of Indonesia, but also the its weird parts. The road full of holes, illegal street merchants, becak, kuntilanaks, you can find everything Indonesia here. Navigate your way to the Nusantara map and strategize your way to victory. 

[h1]New Playable Mascot: Burglar[/h1]

Introducing our latest mascot, the Burglar. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/38894d4be3fafa7852b11fa40b9e16dbe38f008a.png[/img]

This sneaky character brings a unique twist to the game with their special ability to steal a card from another player. Use the Burglar’s skills to outsmart your opponents and gain the upper hand in the game. 

This mascot also comes with an Indonesian-themed skin variant. The skin is inspired by the Indonesian traditional weapon spiked bamboo, which was used by heroes during the Indonesian Independence War. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/240a5a1061b81358e427ab7cf17dd62e4dd77265.png[/img]

[h1]New Skins[/h1] 

Celebrate Indonesian Independence Day in style with new skins for some of your favorite mascots: 

[h2]Spiked Bamboo Fisherman[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/31f02576bb39061cf5672335cc932f8fbefef28b.png[/img]


“Catch” your opponent off guard with this distinguished and traditional look.  

[h2]Municipal Police[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/be1f33460307031e96adf4ede1f6c11302418460.png[/img]

The enemy of all illegal street merchants, show your dominance with this special police skin. 

[h2]Dukun Shaman[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/d84a678349c33b01a5e86fc6be1108dd49aff83a.png[/img]

Channel ancient wisdom with the mystical and ceremonial attire of Dukun, the holder of Javanese sacred magic arts. 

[h1]New Cards[/h1] 

Enhance your gameplay with four exciting new cards: 

[h2]Fresh Start[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/513f83f098996389446ccdad64c4375bc9c0bd0d.jpg[/img]


Reset the game phase to gain a strategic advantage. 

[h2]Sprint[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/3ced42f6c16dfe6d37933f192b139f68677a1804.jpg[/img]

Move ahead quickly and leave your opponents behind, with a cost 

[h2]Snail Pace[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/56d24224104533e8e928de5c36ad0fbd07265d1a.jpg[/img]

Strategically slow down the game. 

[h2]Daylight Robbery[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/513f83f098996389446ccdad64c4375bc9c0bd0d.jpg[/img]

Swap your entire hand with another player’s. Create a chaotic situation in the game. 

[h1]Indonesian Independence Day Event[/h1] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/35712826d8dec377b961089b5937277cf9b94db0.png[/img]

Join our special Indonesian Independence Day event and play the game on our new map. Collect our Dragon Essence and exchange it for exclusive special items. Don’t miss out on the chance to celebrate this historic day with unique rewards and surprises 

Are you interested? These exciting updates are available starting from today! Explore the Nusantara Map, play as the Burglar, and enjoy all the new skins, cards, and special event content. Your feedback has been instrumental in shaping these updates, and we’re eager to hear your thoughts once you’ve had a chance to dive in. 

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm for our game. We hope you enjoy this special Indonesian Independence Day update as much as we enjoyed creating it for you. Happy gaming! 

Best Regards,
Algorocks

notes.title: DADOO's June Update: Superhero Event and New Login System
notes.content:
Hello Heroes, 

We are thrilled to announce a superhero-themed update this June 2024! This update is packed with various new characters, skins, maps, cards, and many more. Here’s a sneak peek at what you can expect: 

[h1]Introducing Our New Mascot: CAPTAIN MAN  [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/91267d892c11d8af6ca1da959fd0f6c651a030ef.jpg[/img]

Meet our latest mascot, CAPTAIN MAN, ready to lead the charge with his incredible ability MIGHTY BLAST.  

CAPTAIN MAN comes with two striking skins: BLACK THUNDER and LAVA FIST. Customize your hero and unleash their full potential in the game! 

[h1]Superhero-Inspired Skins  [/h1]

Get ready to transform your old mascots with new superhero-inspired skins: 

[list]
[*]THE BADMAN for Policeman Mascot.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/a96eb37f21463e976c71d091cd4563db5de9c4fe.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/41ebe1d840a45abee8519abbc68bd6e6dfeb37e7.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/975e0f52d9af88407c672e64dbc12bdf9c7b8cb3.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/4eb521ee3b027d35b5ae2ef116f958cdc555b4ef.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/13c0d48ac4091f539bef48d8ac294b22575984b3.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/cc8dbeb50fa33473b4488320d5e1bde755f00a27.jpg[/img][/url]

Megapolis is the place where the superheroes reside. Navigate through skyscrapers, The hero gym, and vibrant streets as you battle your way to victory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/b5055e5f138427579e942dac0222d425e06b5a14.jpg[/img]

Maybe that’s it. Thank you for playing our game. If you have any suggestions or want to report a bug, you can contact us on social media below. Get ready to don your capes, power up, and join us for an unforgettable superhero adventure!

notes.title: DADOO May 2024 Update: Simplified Chinese Update and Turbo Time!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce the May 2024 update for our game. Based on the feedback we received on Our Discord survey, we hope these new features can enhance your playing experience. 

Here’s what’s coming your way:

[h1]Turbo Time[/h1]
We’re excited to introduce the Turbo Time feature! After five turns have passed, an extra dice will be added to the game, accelerating the pace and shortening overall playtime. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/7d82b70f8fc556fb858534ddccae483aa549042f.jpg[/img]

This feature is added because, on our feedback survey on Discord, the player base said that the optimal playing time for this game would be around 10-20 minutes. However, based on our data, our average game time hovered around 20-30 minutes, especially if all four players are human, not bot.

With Turbo Time, we aim to bring that down to 10-15 minutes, aligning with your ideal playtime preferences. Get ready for faster, more dynamic matches!

[h1]Simplified Chinese Localization[/h1]
We’re pleased to announce that we are adding Simplified Chinese localization, the most requested language from our community. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/a7ae447c4e4968ae02120b64c033c64f4a3cd30e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/48212a76ffa4de8e6f6103b284caabc8746913f2.jpg[/img]

We hope this will make our game more accessible and enjoyable for our Chinese-speaking players, particularly on Steam. Dive into the game with full language support and eexperience the game in the Chinese language.

[h1]Improved Japanese Localization[/h1]
During our recent discussions with a potential partner from Japan, it was brought to our attention that our Japanese localization needed refinement. Taking their valuable advice to heart, we have significantly improved the quality of our Japanese localization. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/d1fe145aeba6bbe56b41283d22c7baee481d514a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/a61f5d748335c158e4151d7b82fdce7e4dc69a4d.jpg[/img]

All in-game text has been meticulously rewritten to ensure clarity and enhance the gaming experience for our Japanese players. We hope this will make our game more understandable and enjoyable for our Japanese audience.

[h1]Simplified Tutorial[/h1]

The new tutorial is shorter and more effective at teaching the basics of the game. We hope this streamlined version will help new players get up to speed quickly and enjoy the game to its fullest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/fdfeffa4f613bb5393d9f51a1eb83b19a533c232.jpg[/img]

Beside those four major updates, we also fix some bugs like the Tornado bug and the small animation/tile effect in the Icy Peak Map. If you still find any bugs or have any feedback, please don't hesitate to contact us via Steam forum or the social media/email below

Best regards,
Algorocks

notes.title: DADOO's April 2024 Devlog
notes.content:
Greetings, DADOO masters! Thank you for playing DADOO: Twists, Turns, and Mischiefs. 

It has been a month since our game was released on Steam. For those who already purchased our game, thank you very much. We also want to thank you all for the feedback. If you have any feedback too, please head to our Discord channel or social media

In this post, we want to share our plan for DADOO’s future update. Please understand that not all these features will be implemented in the next update. There is still a lot of testing to be done. However, we’ll try to deliver them as fast as we can. 

Here are four major plans that we will implement for the future.  

[h1]Wild West Map[/h1]

Get ready to explore uncharted territories with our latest addition to the game—a brand new Wild West map! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/8afd20fc418e1844335a59450122623c290163e8.jpg[/img]

Immerse yourself in stunning desert landscapes, avoid getting tangled with the cactus, and adapt your strategies to conquer this stunning desert terrain. 

[h1]Chat Feature[/h1]

When playing a social game like DADOO, communication is key. That’s why we want to implement a chat feature to facilitate interaction among players.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/be1fb3f5e307cb47bde6d1e1713f41d01bb49e2b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/75d98e9aef6ab3219ee00ce0a1663ff717ce0710.jpg[/img]

The chat will appear on the left, beside the player list. To activate the chat, just click the dialogue balloon icon on the right of the emoji icon. Hopefully. It’ll help you talk to the other players. 

Oh, to keep our game rating consistent, we also make sure the bad words are censored. You still can play this game with your family. Don't worry.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/747a6680e1795bfc0b907304dd26372453d83d76.jpg[/img]

[h1]Friend Feature[/h1]

Remember that lonely unused "Friend" button on the left side of the screen. Good news: it'll be available soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/832834c3d1ab743c044001fe6c04423446701747.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/6e6baba90159c644300d43a768754a6f2afe170f.png[/img]

You can add another player as a friend or invite them to play with you. With the Chat and Friend feature, we hope you can easily connect with other players from all around the world. 

[h1]New character: Shaman and Botanist[/h1]

Last but certainly not least, we're thrilled to introduce a new character to join the ranks of our ever-growing roster. They are:

[h2]Shaman[/h2]

From the person who can connect us with worldly spirits, a shaman has the ability to control our nature. In our game, The shaman can give a random bad status effect to a player. Yes, it doesn't have a 100% chance of success. But hey, that's just how a shaman works irl too, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/9e42173843cf4538c2370000558eaae06e2d7c4d.jpg[/img]

Oh, the shaman also comes with 2 skins: Whiteseer and Thunderbird Whisperer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/237f0a615ea6498201f2ebc2cc22c9964eed703a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/3b74ddc46f183a70744b02999628d9e59fb65a79.jpg[/img]

[h2]Botanist[/h2]
The one who likes to experiment with things. While a botanist can't control nature like a shaman, they certainly can help them grow. In our game, The Botanist can grow a poisonous plant that can confuse your opponent. Very good ability to have, and annoying to deal with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514967/c5f618a337ec8aa90e62d634e3076c53b5977503.jpg[/img]

For now, the botanist only comes with a default skin. But don't worry, we'll add that in the future.

Other than those four major updates, we also plan for the various bug fixes, new cards, and new skins for the mascots. You guys have been asking for new fisherman skins. Don't worry, we'll add that in the future. we also plan to add a new skin for the Policeman mascot too. So, don't worry.

We can't wait for you to experience these exciting updates! Stay tuned for more information on the major update release and additional details as we develop these new features. Thank you for your continued support and dedication to our game. Happy playing! 

Best regards,
Algorocks

notes.title: DADOO: Twists, Turns, and Mischiefs is Now Available on Steam
notes.content:
On Friday (15/3), DADOO: Twists, Turns, and Mischiefs is now available on Steam as an Early Access game!

DADOO: Twists, Turns, and Mischiefs is an online multiplayer snake and ladder game that you can play with your friends. However, this is no ordinary Snake and Ladder game. DADOO: Twists, Turns, and Mischiefs is a ruthless battlefield where your strategic thinking is tested. Change the course of the game with your skill cards. Push your enemy to their demise. Be the first one to reach the finish line. Remember, don't be nice while playing this game.

[previewyoutube=5gPG_Ldp7b8;full][/previewyoutube]

DADOO: Twists, Turns, and Mischiefs is also a cross-platform game. You can play with your friends anywhere, anytime, with any device. So, what are you waiting for? Roll the dice and invite your friend to experience this chaotic friendship-breaking gameplay.

The Steam version of the game will include the Steam-exclusive mascot character PRO GAMER. Also available with the Steam purchase is a new skill card CANNON RIDE. Grab the Steam version now with a 20% discount, and enjoy its special perks.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44514967/75df713f573d2ef9688925c21cd4435cf5ab9719.jpg[/img]

If you already own the game, don't forget to join our community on Discord. If you find any bugs or have any suggestions, please do not hesitate to contact us via Discord, social media, Steam community, or email at feedback@algo.rocks. Thank you, and have a nice day!
